knowledge.name: Synthetic utility account records
knowledge.detail: Four fictional accounts provide services, balances, status, autopay, and payment history for read-only resident-service review.

knowledge.name: Meter usage and rate evidence
knowledge.detail: Fixed water and sewer histories, tiered rates, and bill amounts support deterministic anomaly and draft-cost analysis.

knowledge.name: Leak-adjustment policy controls
knowledge.detail: Packaged rules require repair evidence, prior-adjustment review, and billing-specialist approval before any adjustment.

knowledge.name: Assistance and payment criteria
knowledge.detail: Synthetic program, poverty-level, document, discount, benefit, and installment rules ground preliminary screening.

intelligence_processing.name: Read-only account explanation
intelligence_processing.detail: Summarizes balances, services, status, and payment history without changing the account, service, payment, or bill.

intelligence_processing.name: Usage and possible-leak screening
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares meter history with a fixed baseline and flags possible anomalies without diagnosing a leak or ordering field work.

intelligence_processing.name: Draft adjustment evidence review
intelligence_processing.detail: Calculates a non-binding policy estimate and lists evidence required for an authorized billing specialist to review.

intelligence_processing.name: Payment-plan option modeling
intelligence_processing.detail: Calculates three-, six-, nine-, and twelve-month options without creating an agreement or changing a balance.

intelligence_processing.name: Preliminary assistance screening
intelligence_processing.detail: Compares supplied household facts with synthetic criteria without determining eligibility, applying, or enrolling anyone.

clients_user_interface.name: Portable Brainstem chat and API
clients_user_interface.detail: The BasicAgent-compatible Python tool exposes four grounded workflows through local chat, streaming, and tool routing.

clients_user_interface.name: Copilot Studio Draft experience
clients_user_interface.detail: Four skills and two synthetic knowledge files passed locked preview cases while the exported agent remained unpublished.

clients_user_interface.name: Evidence-first staff responses
clients_user_interface.detail: Service, billing, revenue, and assistance reviewers receive facts, estimates, criteria, and explicit approval boundaries.

management_reporting.name: Account balance review brief
management_reporting.detail: Presents current and past-due balances, services, status, and payment history for authorized service-staff verification.

management_reporting.name: Usage and policy evidence brief
management_reporting.detail: Shows meter periods, baselines, anomaly indicators, estimates, and missing evidence for billing-specialist review.

management_reporting.name: Payment option comparison
management_reporting.detail: Lists installment durations and modeled amounts while reserving plan approval for billing staff and the resident.

management_reporting.name: Assistance screening summary
management_reporting.detail: Reports potential matches, limits, benefits, and required documents without making an eligibility or enrollment decision.

tools.name: UtilityBillingAssistanceAgent tool
tools.detail: A single BasicAgent-compatible Python file implements four deterministic workflows over bundled synthetic evidence.

tools.name: Deterministic billing functions
tools.detail: Python calculations derive balances, usage trends, draft credits, installment options, and income-threshold screens.

tools.name: Synthetic knowledge package
tools.detail: Two packaged files supply fictional records, rules, controls, rate structures, and assistance criteria.

tools.name: Brainstem RAPP runtime
tools.detail: The local-first server discovers the portable agent and serves grounded chat without utility-system credentials.

tools.name: Deployment-selected foundation model
tools.detail: The environment model routes requests and composes answers from bounded agent or Copilot Studio evidence.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot Studio
tools.detail: Hosts the validated Draft agent, four skills, and two knowledge files; publication requires a separate decision.

tools.name: Utility and metering systems
tools.detail: Approved future read seams for billing and meter records; the evidence package has no live connector or write action.

tools.name: Assistance case-management system
tools.detail: An approved future read seam for program cases; no application, enrollment, outreach, or record update is enabled.

supporting_features.name: Synthetic-only grounding
supporting_features.detail: All accounts, meter readings, policies, rates, programs, and applicant facts are fictional and fixed for evaluation.

supporting_features.name: Four bounded service workflows
supporting_features.detail: Routing is limited to billing inquiry, usage analysis, payment-plan options, and assistance-program screening.

supporting_features.name: Service and billing reviewer authority
supporting_features.detail: Authorized service and billing staff retain verification, adjustment, agreement, eligibility, and enrollment authority.

supporting_features.name: No bill or account adjustment
supporting_features.detail: The agent never changes a balance, payment, service, account, discount, credit, payment plan, or assistance record.

supporting_features.name: No customer contact
supporting_features.detail: Responses are internal decision support; the agent never sends notices, email, Teams messages, calls, or outreach.

supporting_features.name: No diagnosis or field action
supporting_features.detail: An anomaly is not a leak diagnosis, and the agent never schedules inspection, repair, dispatch, or other field work.

supporting_features.name: Validated unpublished package
supporting_features.detail: All four locked cases passed Brainstem and Copilot Studio evidence; the exported solution remains Draft and unpublished.
